name: ecommerce-multi-tender-payments-filament
description: The operator surface for multi-tender payments. It reads plans, tenders and outstanding balances, and records reversals. It invents nothing.
features: Read-only payment plan list and detail, with the outstanding balance computed by the domain fold
The append-only tender ledger presented as a relation manager with no edit and no delete
Recording a reversal against a captured tender, with the domain as the only authority on whether it is allowed
Every Filament ability enumerated by name and denied unless the host grants it
Gateway references hidden behind their own ability and never searchable or filterable
Fails closed when panel tenancy is enabled, because the domain publishes no tenant column
